quotes.text: As of SDK 6.0.0, `captureMethod` defaults to automatic-asynchronous
For React Native SDK `0.0.1-beta.34` and later, explicitly set `captureMethod: 'manual'`
Each `PaymentIntent` can have a maximum of 10 incremental authorization attempts, including declines.
Regardless, when using `amount_to_capture` we recommend that you always check for potential failures.

November server cURL creation uses allowed_payment_method_types[] with card_present, unlike May Node payment_method_types; distinguish request-field wording from the otherwise presentational cURL substitution for create/increment/capture and the Swift example’s SGD-to-JPY change. SDK migration links and Stripe Sales are retrieval routes associated with substantive qualifications.

Higher capture amounts trigger an attempted auto-increment with the specific eligible on-receipt overcapture exception.
Keep issuer-dependent pending authorization display and one captured-total entry.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/incremental-authorizations, both captures require a fully online POS and reader, setting card-present incremental authorization support and manual capture when the merchant integration creates the PaymentIntent, then confirming the payment client-side and checking the latest Charge’s incremental_authorization_supported field. Only confirmed uncaptured payments can be incremented; before confirmation use the update method. November adds the scoped UnionPay private preview and explicit manual-capture instructions for iOS/Android 6.0.0 and React Native 0.0.1-beta.34 onward (old raw lines 14-36, old raw lines 130-134, old raw line 239; new raw lines 15-44, new raw lines 131-135, new raw line 241). The merchant backend provides a higher total; Stripe attempts authorization for the difference, up to 10 attempts including declines. Success updates the amount; decline leaves the prior authorization intact and discards other attempted field updates. Capture above the currently authorized amount normally attempts auto-increment, except eligible on-receipt tipping uses overcapture; monitor capture failures. The issuer determines pending display, while the captured total appears once (old raw line 10, old raw lines 241-291; new raw line 11, new raw lines 243-279). source-stripe-terminal-incremental-authorizations covers the May mechanism, but lacks the new eligibility/default boundaries and reads too broadly on capture success.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/incremental-authorizations, update source-stripe-terminal-incremental-authorizations and its reciprocal stripe-terminal-incremental-authorizations route. May 1 names four networks; November 7 adds China UnionPay private preview in named APAC/European countries for specified rental, hotel/motel/resort and cruise categories, via Stripe Sales. Keep full online, attempt and MCC conditions (old raw lines 14-36; new raw lines 15-44). Record iOS/Android 6.0.0 and React Native 0.0.1-beta.34 explicit manual capture despite incomplete Swift/Kotlin creation snippets. React Native switches the demonstration from ID collection/processPayment to object collection/confirmPaymentIntent, and server create changes from payment_method_types to allowed_payment_method_types[] in the displayed request. Treat Node-to-cURL increment/capture and example currency changes as presentational, the migration pointers as routes (old raw lines 40-56, old raw lines 153-159, old raw lines 204-236, old raw lines 247-284; new raw lines 42-55, new raw lines 62-68, new raw lines 82-97, new raw lines 154-160, new raw lines 205-238, new raw lines 249-271). Preserve the on-receipt tipping link and overcapture eligibility and limits; scope the prior 'always succeeds' wording to the guide's no-auto-increment exception and retain the check-for-failures instruction (old raw lines 265-291; new raw lines 260-279).
